SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Punctuation Marks in German Braille • Speech Marks • Colon. • Semicolon ., part of German Braille in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How can we identify and use speech marks, colon, and semicolon correctly in German Braille?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
